title: Plan Settings: currency/placement/number format changes do not re-render amounts until reload
notes:
Pre-existing (identical in syscd). Only budget/ui/MenuPanes.tsx subscribes to fmtPrefs (useFmtPrefs); the shell subscribes to the money mask only, so formatMoney callers keep the old format until something else re-renders. Repro: Settings > Plan Settings > 1,314.51; plan amounts stay 1.314,51 until reload. Found in the phase 3 parity pass (docs/evidence/parity/REPORT.md).
Fixed on tk/budget-sfa (3d4bc09): prefs live in the budgetUi slice, components format through useMoneyFormat(), so a format change re-renders amounts immediately. Browser proof: docs/evidence/phase5e/xef-1-before-change-pt-BR.png -> xef-2-live-en-US-no-reload.png (Plan, rail, RTA, inspector all switch to 1,314.51 without reload).
Fixed in phase 5a: formatters read prefs from the budgetUi slice via useMoneyFormat(), so a format change re-renders live; evidence docs/evidence/phase5e/xef-*.png (4cb4abf), merged 4c3532b. Re-checked 2026-11-18 wrap-up: a number-format change persisted across a reload on the 2026.11.18-01 code.
